meaning:
ζημία, -ας, ἡ
[in LXX for עָנַשׁ; עֹנֶשׁ ni. and cognate forms ;]
damage, loss: Act.27:10, 21 Php.3:8; opposite to κέρδος, Php.3:7.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: and said to them, “Sirs, I perceive that the voyage will be with injury and much loss, not only of the cargo and the ship, but also of our lives.”
However, I consider those things that were gain to me as a loss for Christ.
